prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1152; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a residential street in Pearland, Texas, heading toward the grocery store.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was going maybe fifteen miles an hour. The other car came over into my lane and we hit nose to nose, but it wasn't a hard hit.
Q: Did either vehicle have time to brake?
A: The other driver braked, I think. I tried to steer right but there wasn't much room.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, and the airbags did not deploy.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?
A: I did, but my left knee was really sore and I had trouble putting weight on it.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that day. They took an X-ray and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor.
Q: Have you experienced any knee problems before this collision?
A: I had some stiffness years ago after running, but nothing that stopped me from working or walking.
Q: How would you describe your knee pain today?
A: It swells up by the evening, and stairs are hard. I'm using a brace and I've been limping on it.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: Yes, a few shifts so far. I'm waiting on my doctor to tell me how long I'll be restricted.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?
A: Only that the other driver seemed apologetic at the scene, and I want my knee taken seriously.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thanks.
